rules.statement: The right of pre-emption under the Tesavalamai is limited to adjacent owners who are mortgagees, and not to non-adjacent mortgagees.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, therefore, the right of pre-emption only lies in the adjacent owner who happens to be a mortgagee of the land, and I therefore think that the plaintiffs are not entitled to the right they claim under the Tesavalamai"
